{{Short description|Football tournament stage}}
The '''2024 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 2 April to 8 June 2024.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Fixture-Libertadores_Fase-de-Grupos-CL-2024_19-03-2024.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2024 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 19/03/024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 March 2024|access-date=19 March 2024}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2024 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2024-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=13 December 2023|access-date=17 March 2024}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw /><noinclude>
The draw for the group stage was held on 18 March 2024, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/sorteo-de-fase-de-grupos-en-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2024/|title=Sorteo de Fase de Grupos en la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=Group Stage Draw in the 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=15 March 2024|access-date=17 March 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/grupos-definidos-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-2024/|title=¡Un nuevo comienzo hacia La Gloria Eterna!|trans-title=A new beginning towards The Eternal Glory!|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 March 2024|access-date=18 March 2024}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 18 December 2023 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Ranking-CONMEBOL-2024-Final-1.pdf|title=Ranking de Clubes de la CONMEBOL 2024|trans-title=2024 CONMEBOL Clubs Ranking|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 December 2023|access-date=17 March 2024|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2014–2023.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2013 and 2002–2013 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/><ref name="fixture April">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Fixture-Libertadores_Fase-de-Grupos-CL-2024_15-04-2024.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2024 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 15/04/024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=15 April 2024|access-date=18 April 2024}}</ref>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]] of the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana]].<section end=Format />
